Firefly changes only the SKILL.md frontmatter: the directory ID as `name`, `effectKind: read`, `modes` and `hiddenFromUi`. The upstream body and every reference file are byte-for-byte identical to the pinned commit. The text is instruction-only guidance; it grants no tool, file, network or credential authority and does not authorize any action. This is a maintained adaptation, not an unmodified upstream distribution.
